d:
Bihar sarkar ne chhath se pahle mahangaee bhatte (DA) aur mahangaee rahat (DR) men barhotri ki ghoshna ki hai. vahin, 7ven vetan aayog ke tahat DA/DR ki daron men ijapha kiya gaya hai. iske alava, shahri nikayon ke karmachariyon ke lie sanshodhit MACP yojna lagu ki jaegi.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
